verdict.rationale: Decagon's docs say the agent can take real actions rather than just answering. Integrations let it retrieve data, take action and handle escalations, and Browser Actions lets it log in and complete tasks in systems without integrations, which supports end-to-end resolution. However, there is no evidence of actual resolution rates, and no metric that separates true resolutions from deflections; reporting mentions only generic 'key metrics'. missing for 10: published or independent resolution-rate figures, documented resolution-vs-deflection measurement, customer outcomes tied to end-to-end resolution, hands-on corroboration.
